checks: Typed output values, physical source ordinals and coordinates, and every evidence record
Exact source bytes and metadata, portable file hashes, and saved job identity
Paused jobs publish no export; source removal and grant removal do not prevent verified resume
Malformed sources, invalid UTF-8, missing grants and input ceilings fail without publishing exports
A 512-row committed prefix survives schema rejection of row 513; no failed export is published
Tampered saved rows/chunks/checkpoints and changed resume contracts are refused; previously verified exports stay unchanged

independent_reconstruction.method: Standard-library regeneration of frozen synthetic source/output/proof/manifest bytes; streamed SHA-256 comparison against every reported bundle digest

limitations.large_case_scope: 100,000 JSONL input rows through installed API, with JSONL and typed CSV exports; CLI format cases use 649 rows or one asset record.

resources.measurement_limits: Single-worker RSS is not aggregate host memory. Generated disk usage is sampled, not a kernel quota. Cold subprocess imports, verification and repeated exports are included in case wall times; this is not the earlier throughput benchmark.

scope: Installed streaming regression with synthetic sources; qualified preinstalled dependencies
